verdicts.reason: A: at banner size, 'Sunset Sessions' is split over two lines and the subtitle is squeezed into a narrow column about five lines tall, so the type is too small to read. The logo is gone, and the three pills, the date block and the RSVP button sit against each other with no gutters, so the left-to-right strip is cramped and has no clear focal point. B: the headline stays on one line, the logo and the ticket survive, and the subtitle wraps in two lines, which makes the reading order clearer. It is still overstuffed, though: the logo, subtitle and date text are tiny and illegible, the stacked pills and the tiny ticket crowd the RSVP button, and there is almost no breathing room.
